problem: Store managers are manually reconciling loyalty redemptions against POS reports every Monday. It takes two people about three hours, numbers often disagree, and nobody is sure whether the source is the POS, loyalty platform, or export process.
Customer refund requests are copied from email into a spreadsheet, then manually checked against Stripe and our CRM. The queue is growing and managers cannot see which cases are high risk.

Regional managers say inventory forecasts are unreliable. Each store maintains separate spreadsheets and head office combines them once a week, but nobody has quantified how often the forecast is wrong or why.

New customer onboarding requires sales to email implementation, implementation re-enters account details in another system, and finance later corrects billing fields. Some customers are contacted late, but we do not have a reliable measure of the delay.
